title: Ro ro maqtal mein kehti thi Zainab
body:
Ro ro maqtal mein kehti thi Zainab
bhaiyya baali Sakina kahan hae
Jaake dhoondhun kahan usko bun mein
shab hae taareek sannata run mein
Hookh uthti hae mere badan mein
bhaiyya baali Sakina kahan hae
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth ke dariya se Abbas aao
saath Akbar ko tum letey aao
Dhoondh kar tum Sakina ko laao
bhaiyya baali Sakina kahan hae
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho chuki run mein sham-e ghareeban
fouje aada mein ab hae chiraagan
Kooch ke ho rahe hai yeh saaman
bhaiyya baali Sakina kahan hae
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhaiyya dekho toh qismat hamari
jayegi kis tarah yeh sawari
Hogi mehmil na ab woh amaari
bhaiyya baali Sakina kahan hae
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashe besar se aawaz aayi
gham na khao ae amma ki jaai
Aao behna bulaata hae bhayi
meri baali Sakina yahan hae
<<DIVIDER>>
Rothay rothay jo neend aagayi hae
gham ke toofan mein woh kho gayi hae
Mere seene pah woh so gayi hae
meri baali Sakina kahan hae
